Paragraph: "Seetha used to weave such blossoms into garlands for me; now those same flowers lie scattered, forgotten on the dirt..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Fallen flowers evoke memories of Seetha weaving garlands, contrasting past affection with present disorder.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama recalls Seetha's loving gestures triggered by the sight of fallen flowers.
Outcome/Resolution: He experiences a poignant wave of nostalgic grief.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Anuraga-Smriti (Memories of tender, loving actions performed by a devoted partner)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Recalling tender acts of devotion shows how love sanctifies simple material things like forest flowers.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Memory trigger: observing everyday items (flowers) reactivates grief over lost intimate couple rituals.
